purpose: Independently replay a frozen complete-trace candidate against the frozen source-only reference without consulting historical lane outputs or receipts.

candidate.role: frozen canonical replay candidate; its cases are intentionally identical to the frozen reference for source-fidelity replay
candidate.boundary: This candidate permits an independent source-replay and grader-control receipt. It is not a blind-extractor output and cannot establish independent extraction or corpus acceptance.

required_checks: Verify each declared input digest before grading.
Run the grader against the declared candidate path; require zero missed, false, and source replay failures in every row.
Run the grader self-check; it must reject the tracked removed-span and corrupted-quote controls.
Run record-integrity validation after the final package bytes are fixed and bind its package_root_sha256 in the verifier receipt.
receipt_requirements: Identify the fresh verifier context and declared candidate digest.
Record exact command, stdout, stderr, and exit status for candidate grade, control self-check, and integrity validation.
State only the source-only complete-trace result; do not claim runtime behavior, architecture selection, or publication closure.
